ns2:course.label: Everyday Arts Lab
ns2:course.description: This class examines community-based art projects that partner undergraduates with youth (K-12) in non-university settings including community centers and schools. Through this course, students will design and teach arts and public engagement projects. They will explore their identities as artists, educators, and citizens. Students will learn how to assess impact of their projects and teaching. The course welcomes all students; no prior teaching or community-based education experience necessary. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule.
